page.title: Artifact graph
page.description: Read-only business lineage between package versions: every edge points from a source version to the exact version that used it. Relations are created by review, comparison and revision actions; dragging only pans the canvas.
page.noProjectsText: The artifact graph is built from delivered package versions inside a project.
page.noProjectSelected: Select a project to view its artifact graph.

toolbar.graphHint: Source version → target version. Relations only come from business actions and cannot be changed by dragging.

canvas.nodeListHint: The same nodes as a keyboard-accessible list.
canvas.panHint: Drag to pan · scroll to zoom · relations are read-only

node.noVersionsHint: This package has no formal version yet, so there is nothing to expand.

details.title: Details
details.emptyText: Read exact endpoints, scope and time. Opening a package or version never changes the selected snapshot.
details.hintDirection: Edges always point from source version to target version.
details.hintReadonly: Relations are read-only facts; dragging only pans the canvas.
details.hintExpand: Show the versions of a package to read v1, v2 … and their exact endpoints.
details.aggregatedRelations: This edge aggregates {{count}} relations. Exact endpoints may differ:
details.endpointUnavailable: A recorded endpoint version is no longer available. The relation keeps its reference, but the content cannot be opened.
details.edgeNote: Opening an endpoint does not change the relation or this snapshot.
details.unavailable: This object is not available in the current data.
details.branchHint: Branch actions pre-select this exact version in the create wizard.

empty.title: No artifact relations yet
empty.text: Relations are created by independent review, version comparison or explicit revision. This project has no related packages yet.

emptyFiltered.title: No relation matches the current filters
emptyFiltered.text: Clear a filter or reset all filters to see the project graph again.

emptyPackages.title: This project has no packages yet
emptyPackages.text: Create a generation package first; review and comparison packages will then connect exact versions in this graph.

emptyProject.title: Project not found
emptyProject.text: This project does not exist or is no longer available in the demo data.

payload.partialDraft: This draft is a partial working state.

versionPage.notFoundText: This version does not exist, does not belong to the package, or is no longer available in the demo data.

readonly.title: Read-only snapshot
readonly.text: Delivered versions are immutable: inputs, stage results and the deliverable are frozen here. To change the delivery, continue editing to create a new working draft.
readonly.partialText: This version was submitted as a partial delivery. The unfinished scope is recorded and the snapshot stays immutable.
readonly.historicalHint: This is not the latest formal version ({{latest}}). This snapshot stays unchanged.

deliverable.title: Delivered file
deliverable.hint: The frozen deliverable of this version.
deliverable.downloadDemo: Demo mode does not provide real file downloads. The readable preview on this page is the demo content.
deliverable.simulated: Demo environment does not generate real files. The readable content below previews the frozen snapshot.
deliverable.noDocumentText: This deliverable has no readable document in the demo data.
deliverable.readonlySuffix: Read-only preview of this delivered version

inputs.title: Frozen inputs
inputs.hint: Exact material versions recorded at delivery time. Unavailable sources are explicitly marked and were not treated as verified.
inputs.emptyText: This version did not record material inputs.
inputs.unavailableNote: {{count}} recorded input(s) cannot be resolved in the demo data. They are shown as unavailable and are not counted as verified evidence.

artifacts.title: Stage results included in this snapshot
artifacts.hint: Frozen references to stage artifacts at the revision used by this delivery.
artifacts.emptyText: This version did not include stage artifacts.
artifacts.notAvailable: This artifact no longer exists in the current data; the version keeps only the frozen reference.
artifacts.supersededNote: This revision was later replaced by a newer revision. This snapshot still references the revision that was delivered.

confirmations.title: Recorded confirmations
confirmations.hint: Key user confirmations frozen together with this version.
confirmations.emptyText: This version does not record any user confirmation.

relations.title: Sources and follow-ups
relations.hint: Exact version-level relations around this snapshot. Opening an endpoint does not change this version.
relations.emptyText: This version has no recorded cross-package relations yet.

continueEdit.title: Create a working draft from this version?
continueEdit.text: A new working draft will be created in package {{code}} based on {{label}}. The delivered version stays unchanged; submitting the draft creates the next formal version.
continueEdit.historyHint: {{label}} is not the latest formal version ({{latest}}). Continuing creates a new draft based on {{label}}; the latest formal version is not affected.
